sloka: शिला पिधाना काकुत्स्थ दुःखम् च अस्याः प्रवेशनम् ।तस्या गुहायाः प्राक् द्वारे महान् शीत उदको ह्रदः ॥३-७३-४०॥
transliteration: śilā pidhānā kākutstha duḥkham ca asyāḥ praveśanam ।tasyā guhāyāḥ prāk dvāre mahān śīta udako hradaḥ ॥3-73-40॥

translations.english: At the eastern entrance of the cave there is a cool watertank. On its bank teeming with various animals are delightful fruits and roots.
